notes: Series play: pick FT2, FT3 or FT5 when you make a room and the first side to that many wins takes the series; a level match in a series is settled by the board's own penalty shoot-out. A 2v2 now comes back to the room after every match, like a 1v1. On the results page the replay link copies its address, and Game - Replays in the launcher plays it straight away. The game window opens where it last was, and the keys that pause a match are locked while playing.
